description_en: Queries the parameters that are required to upload a file for detection
name: CreateFileDetectUploadUrl

parameters.help_en:
The identifiers of files. Only MD5 hash values are supported.

You must specify at least one of the HashKeyList and HashKeyContextList parameters
parameters.help_zh:
文件唯一标识。列表最多传入100个元素。
HashKeyList 和 HashKeyContextList不能同时为空
parameters.name: hash_key_list

parameters.help_en:
The type of the file. Valid values:

0: unknown file
1: binary file
2: webshell file
4: script file

If you do not know the type of the file, set this parameter to 0
parameters.help_zh:
文件类型。取值：
0：不确定的文件类型
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en: The size of the file. Unit: bytes
fields.help_zh: 文件大小。如果文件大小超过限制，将不会返回上传参数。单位：字节
fields.name: file_size

fields.help_en: The hash value of the file
fields.name: hash_key

parameters.help_en:
The hash values of files.

You must specify at least one of the HashKeyList and HashKeyContextList parameters
parameters.help_zh:
文件标识。目前仅支持MD5。列表最多传入100个元素。
HashKeyList 和 HashKeyContextList不能同时为空
parameters.name: hash_key_context_list

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UploadUrlList.description_en: An array consisting of the parameters that are required to upload a file
UploadUrlList.description_zh: 文件上传需要的参数集合

Code.description_en: The status code returned. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other status codes indicate that the request failed. You can identify the cause of the failure based on the status code
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

AccessId.description_en: The AccessKey ID that is used to access the OSS bucket

OssKey.description_en: The key of the file that is used after the file is uploaded to the OSS bucket

Policy.description_en: The policy that poses limits on file upload. For example, the policy can limit the size of the file
Policy.description_zh: 文件上传的限制Policy，如文件大小

Signature.description_en: The signature that is used to upload the file

Expire.description_en: The timestamp when the values of the parameters expire. Unit: milliseconds
Expire.description_zh: 上传参数过期的时间戳，单位为毫秒

FileExist.description_en:
Indicates whether the file exists in the cloud. Valid values:

true: The file exists in the cloud. You do not need to upload the file.
false: The file does not exist in the cloud. You must upload the file
FileExist.description_zh:
文件是否存在。取值：

true：文件已存在，不需要上传。
false：文件不存在，需要上传

InternalUrl.description_en: The internal endpoint of the URL to which the file is uploaded

PublicUrl.description_en: The public endpoint of the URL to which the file is uploaded
